title: Boyd Bushman talks antigravity

tellings.quote: I sit down and interview uh Boyd for a documentary I was making at the time called Ben Rich Secret.

plain: A man named Boyd Bushman, linked in this story to Lockheed Martin in Fort Worth, is said to have talked about antigravity, meaning a way to cancel or beat gravity. Nick Cook tells Michels that he sat down and interviewed Bushman himself, for a documentary he was making at the time called Ben Rich Secret. If what Bushman said were true, it would mean such technology was being discussed inside a major American defense company.
